entries.zh: 活；活水（泉源流动不涸之水，与死水相对）
entries.en: spring water; living (running) water
muddy, turbid water

entries.zh: 汤；热水（供烫洗以去皮褪毛之用）
entries.en: hot, scalding water (for stripping off skin or hair)

entries.zh: 汤水；热水（同上，供烫洗去皮之用）
entries.en: hot water (for scalding)
clear running water
entries.notes: H 栏'洚'字训洪水（《孟子》'洚水者洪水也'），与西语'清流'义不甚相合，疑为'泓'（清深之水）之形误；闽南次读音 quiáng 亦待考。

entries.en: clear water (idem, as above)
entries.notes: 同上条：'洚'字形与读音存疑，释义从西语'清水'。

entries.en: flood, floodwater risen beyond its banks
to settle and become clear (of water)
clarified, clear (water); to settle and clear up

entries.zh: 滥；水泛滥（兼指水混杂而浊）
entries.en: to overflow (of flood waters); to mix, commingle (waters)
entries.notes: 西语栏缩写含混（Gua turbia ~ aguas muchas）；'滥'主泛溢、混杂义，与'浑浊'义之对应待核。

entries.en: copious, abundant (of waters)

entries.zh: 蔷薇露；蔷薇（玫瑰）蒸露之花水、香水
entries.en: rose water (distilled from roses)
waters of lakes and seas
entries.notes: 西语作 agua del rio y del mar（江河与海之水），'湖'与 rio 不对应，两栏之间疑有一误。

entries.zh: 船发漏；船漏（水渗入船中）
entries.en: the ship springs a leak; water getting into the vessel

entries.zh: 符水；符咒化水（旧俗奉为灵水，西士目为拜偶像者之'圣水'）
entries.en: talisman water (charmed water of idolatrous rites)
shallow water
stagnant (dead) water that does not flow
sugar water, syrup (of honey or sugar)

entries.zh: 阵；阵雨（骤然而至之一阵雨）
entries.en: a sudden shower, a burst of rain

entries.zh: 风时雨；风雨俱至之阵雨
entries.en: windy shower; rain accompanied by wind
entries.notes: H 栏作'方时雨'，闽南音 hong sî hǒu 与'风时雨'（风雨交加）相合，'方'疑为'风'之形近误写或借字。

entries.zh: 注嘴盥洗水器（洗手用的带嘴水壶/盆）
entries.en: spouted hand-washing ewer; washbasin with a spout
entries.notes: 西语当为 aguamanil de pico（带注嘴之盥洗水器）；H 栏'干砳'（cán phy̌ / cǎn quěy）与此义难以对合，字形与音待考。
